links.outcome: Accuracy, false-negative rates and review time of human reviewers with LLM screening versus without
links.effect: Hybrid accuracy comparable to HR (4o-HYB 80.2%, v3-HYB 82.5%, HR 82.3%) but lower than HR-ex (87.3%); FN rates higher than HR-ex (34.2% and 27.3% vs 16.9%); review time fell from 51.0 s to 11.0-12.0 s.
links.quote: Hybrid workflow (HYB) accuracy was comparable to HR (4o-HYB 80.2%, v3-HYB 82.5%, HR 82.3%) but lower than HR-ex (87.3%).

links.outcome: Whether human verification catches LLM-generated false negatives and false positives in report review
links.effect: Human verification reduced LLM-generated FNs and FPs, though hybrid FN rates (34.2% and 27.3%) remained higher than expert over-read HR-ex (16.9%).
links.quote: Human verification reduced LLM-generated FNs and FPs.

links.outcome: Hybrid LLM-assisted review compared against human reviewers alone and expert over-read control
links.effect: Hybrid accuracy comparable to single human review (80.2%/82.5% vs 82.3%) but lower than HR-ex (87.3%); review time reduced from 51.0 s to 11.0-12.0 s.
links.quote: The LLM-assisted HYB achieved accuracy comparable to single-physician review while substantially reducing audit time.
